name: Berlin School of Business and Innovation (BSBI)
description: In 2018, the Berlin School of Business and Innovation was established as a business school. Students have the chance to travel internationally through BSBI since the university has partners in Athens and Paris which give you a chance to start there and complete your education in Berlin. Moreover, as a component of the Faculty of Creative Industries, BSBI takes great pride in being able to offer programs in Hamburg.
